subtitles.text: Before Veyr had a king, the mountain had a heart.
And House Vaelor gave it theirs.
On the last night, the gates were sealed…
…and the king went down to the heart.
Caer Veyr was torn between two memories of itself.
The kingdom became a story. Then a warning.
Now, a daughter of the forgotten line has come home.

shots.note: Black. The Crownheart wakes in the dark beneath the mountain.
Torchlit founders; a cut palm; the drop lands on "blood"; gold runs through the whorls.
Cutaway: the camera rises through the rock as Caer Veyr grows above it, gilded at dusk.
Same composition: the sky bleeds red, the valley fills with the fires of an army.
Inside the gate passage: the portcullis slams on "sealed"; guards turn their spears inward.
A servants' door: a woman's hand pushes a hooded child into the dark; she looks back; the door shuts.
The spiral stair from above: the crowned shadow descends toward red-gold light.
His gauntlet on the heart; the whorls blaze; bells toll above.
Cutaway: the heart flares; a column of light rises through the rock toward the castle.
The castle blazes gold; its gilded image crazes like old varnish; silence; the Past flakes away to reveal the ruin in register; flakes hang where windows were.
Time-lapse on the ruin: moon, stars, snow, rain, growth; one gold window flickers, then goes out.
Night, now. A woman climbs the overgrown road beneath the dead silhouette.
Behind her, low: the rotted gate, the faded crest; her shield on her back.
Her hand on the crest; the engraving fills with a hairline of red-gold.
Gilding sweeps out from her palm: the living gate, torches, banners, guards turning their heads.
It cracks away. Ruin. Silence. She does not understand.
From inside the dark: the gate groans open, moonlight, her silhouette; she crosses into darkness.
Gold flakes drift up in the dark and assemble: THE CASTLE REMEMBERS.

music.name: crownheart
music.style: darkness, a single low sustained tone, glass harmonica shimmer, sub pulse like a slow heartbeat, sacred and ancient

music.name: binding
music.style: the tone blooms into warm low strings, a slow reverent swell, first hint of the Veyr theme on solo cello

music.name: rise
music.style: noble, reverent processional: the Veyr theme on solo cello over strings and soft horns, building to a warm golden peak

music.name: last_night
music.style: the warmth drains away: low war drums far off, tremolo strings, dissonant low brass, the theme fragmented, dread building, heavy bells tolling at the end

music.name: sundering
music.style: a massive swelling crescendo that shatters, then sudden near-silence

music.name: two_memories
music.style: mournful and suspended: solo cello plays the theme slowly over a thin high string drone, reversed textures, a distant bell, centuries passing

music.name: return
music.style: intimate and restrained: a low heartbeat pulse, sparse piano-less strings, the first notes of the theme, tension rising gently

music.name: threshold
music.style: one brief full statement of the theme, then hush: a low sustained drone as she enters the dark, resolving to a final deep chord for the title
